subject: AP BIOLOGY
pageTitle: Hardy-Weinberg Equation: Find Allele and Genotype Frequencies
description: Use p + q = 1 and p² + 2pq + q² = 1 to find allele frequencies and the percent of carriers, with two worked AP Biology examples.
caption: Hardy-Weinberg in 7 swipes: the two equations, which number to start from, and two worked examples. Save this for your AP Bio unit test. Free AP Biology study guide at precisstudy.com/ap-biology (no sign-up).

slides.title: THE TWO EQUATIONS
slides.note: p = dominant allele, q = recessive allele.

slides.title: WHAT EACH TERM IS
slides.note: Start from q²: it is the only genotype you can see directly.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: 9% of a population has a recessive trait. Find q, p, and the percent of carriers.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: 4% of people have a recessive condition. What fraction are carriers?

slides.title: WATCH OUT
points: 2pq counts both ways to be a carrier (Aa and aA).
The recessive allele is q, not the dominant one.
